parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
anthropology[æ̀nθrəpάlədʒi]n.
Anthropology is the study of people, society, and culture.
→ In anthropology class, I learned about simple tools that ancient cultures used.
😎
applaud[əplɔ́ːd]v.
To applaud means to clap in order to show approval.
→ Everyone cheered and applauded Manny's efforts.
😎
appoint[əpɔ́int]v.
To appoint someone to a job means to give the job to them.
→ Two students were appointed to help the scientists with their research.
😎
compatible[kəmpǽtəbl]adj.
When things are compatible, they work well or exist together successfully.
→ Jan and Fred are too different. They will never be compatible.
😎
competence[kάmpətəns]n.
Competence is the ability to do something well or effectively.
→ The job was easy because the group had enough competence to do it well.
😎
confer[kənfə́ːr]v.
To confer with someone means to discuss something with them to make a decision.
→ I will have to confer with my wife before I can purchase a new car.
😎
consecutive[kənsékjutiv]adj.
When things are consecutive, they happen one after another without interruption.
→ The king ruled for ten consecutive years.
😎
crude[kruːd]adj.
When something is crude, it is not exact or detailed, but it can still be useful.
→ She drew crude hearts on the ground to show how much she loved him.
😎
cube[kjuːb]n.
A cube is a solid object with six square surfaces that are all the same size.
→ Please get me some ice cubes to put in my soda.
😎
feedback[fíːdbæ̀k]n.
Feedback is comments to a person about how they are doing something.
→ I asked my boss for feedback on my work.
😎
ignorance[ígnərəns]n.
Ignorance of something is lack of knowledge about it.
→ When he failed the test, his ignorance of math was obvious.
😎
masculine[mǽskjulin]adj.
When something is masculine, it is a quality or thing related to men.
→ American football is usually considered a masculine sport.
😎
monument[mάnjumənt]n.
A monument is a structure that is built to remind people of a person or event.
→ A large monument was built to honor the brave soldiers.
😎
muscular[mΛskjulər]adj.
When someone is muscular, they are very fit and strong.
→ He exercised regularly so that his body could become muscular.
😎
posture[pάstʃər]n.
A person's posture is the position in which they stand or sit.
→ Your back will feel better if you improve your posture.
😎
situate[sítʃuèit]v.
To situate something means to place or build it in a certain place.
→ The road was situated between the forest and the lake.
😎
supervise[súːpərvàiz]v.
To supervise something means to make sure that it is done correctly.
→ Allen supervised the construction workers to ensure everyone's safety.
😎
symmetry[símətri]n.
Symmetry is the state of having two halves that are exactly the same.
→ The artist made sure to use perfect symmetry when painting the butterfly.
😎
tattoo[tætúː]n.
A tattoo is a design that is drawn permanently on the skin with needles.
→ The surfer had tattoos on both his arms.
😎
undergraduate[Λndərgrǽdʒuət]n.
An undergraduate is a student at a college who is studying fora bachelor's degree.
→ She was excited to finish high school and enroll as an undergraduate in the fall.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: 1. Which would need to be supervised?
questions.explanation: "A new student" (một học sinh mới) cần được giám sát (supervised) để hướng dẫn.

questions.content: 2. What is most likely something that is situated?
questions.explanation: "situated" nghĩa là được đặt/tọa lạc ở một vị trí, phù hợp nhất với "A building" (một tòa nhà).

questions.content: 3. What is something you can be appointed to?
questions.explanation: "appointed to" nghĩa là được bổ nhiệm, nên đi với "A job" (một công việc).

questions.content: 4. If someone confers with another person, ______ .
questions.explanation: "confers" nghĩa là bàn bạc, thảo luận, tương đương với "discuss something".

questions.content: 5. What is something that might be a cube?
questions.explanation: "cube" là hình khối lập phương, thường là "A box" (một cái hộp).

sections.title: Exercise 2: Write a word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content: 1. I feel the best when the hours I sleep are *one after another without interruption*.
questions.explanation: "one after another without interruption" (liên tiếp nhau không ngắt quãng) tương đương với "consecutive".

questions.content: 2. Even though he was young, the boy’s facial features were *qualities related to men*.
questions.explanation: "qualities related to men" (phẩm chất liên quan đến nam giới) là "masculine" (nam tính).

questions.content: 3. My girlfriend and I are happy because we are *successful at existing together*.
questions.explanation: "successful at existing together" (tồn tại cùng nhau thành công) là "compatible" (tương thích, hòa hợp).

questions.content: 4. The *strong and fit* fireman carried the children out of the burning building.
questions.explanation: "strong and fit" (khỏe và cân đối) tương đương với "muscular" (vạm vỡ, cơ bắp).

questions.content: 5. The *college student* handbook lists the classes I need to take to get my degree.
questions.explanation: "college student" (sinh viên đại học) tương đương với "undergraduate" (sinh viên chưa tốt nghiệp đại học).

questions.content: 6. My mother was shocked when she found out I had a *permanent drawing on my skin*.
questions.explanation: "permanent drawing on my skin" (hình vẽ vĩnh viễn trên da) là "tattoo" (hình xăm).

questions.content: 7. The first thing Al noticed about the new employee was his bad *standing position*.
questions.explanation: "standing position" (tư thế đứng) tương đương với "posture" (tư thế).

questions.content: 8. This snowflake has *perfect halves that are the exact same* but mirror images.
questions.explanation: "halves that are the exact same" (các nửa giống hệt nhau) là sự đối xứng ("symmetry").

questions.content: 9. He was embarrassed by his *lack of knowledge*.
questions.explanation: "lack of knowledge" (thiếu kiến thức) tương đương với "ignorance" (sự ngu dốt, thiếu hiểu biết).

questions.content: 10. The *not exact or detailed* measurements turned out to be good enough.
questions.explanation: "not exact or detailed" (không chính xác hoặc không chi tiết) là "crude" (sơ sài, thô).

sections.title: Exercise 3: Write C if the italicized word is used correctly. Write I if the word is used incorrectly.

questions.content: 1. The undergraduate program at our school includes several possible degrees.
questions.explanation: Correct. Chương trình "undergraduate" (đại học) bao gồm nhiều chuyên ngành.

questions.content: 2. She conferred with her coworkers before presenting their work to the boss.
questions.explanation: Correct. "Conferred" (bàn bạc, thảo luận) được dùng đúng.

questions.content: 3. The rain made a cube on the grass.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Mưa không thể tạo ra hình khối lập phương (cube) trên cỏ.

questions.content: 4. The tattoo appeared very dark on her light-colored skin.
questions.explanation: Correct. Hình xăm (tattoo) trông rất đậm trên làn da sáng.

questions.content: 5. Our teacher was quick to give us feedback on our homework.
questions.explanation: Correct. Giáo viên cho "feedback" (nhận xét) là hợp lý.

questions.content: 6. The wall was situated in the north part of the yard.
questions.explanation: Correct. Bức tường "situated" (tọa lạc/được đặt) ở phía bắc sân.

questions.content: 7. The baby supervised her mother in the store.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Em bé không thể giám sát (supervised) mẹ mình.

questions.content: 8. The symmetry of the flower arrangement made it look very attractive.
questions.explanation: Correct. Sự đối xứng (symmetry) làm bình hoa trông hấp dẫn.

questions.content: 9. The angry father applauded his son when he got in trouble at school.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Người cha tức giận sẽ không vỗ tay hoan hô (applauded) khi con gây rắc rối.

questions.content: 10. The manager needed an assistant. She appointed Bill to the new position.
questions.explanation: Correct. Quản lý bổ nhiệm (appointed) người cho vị trí mới.

questions.content: 11. The masculine girl looked very pretty in her new dress.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Một cô gái nam tính (masculine) lại mặc váy thì không hợp lý về mặt ngữ nghĩa ở đây.

questions.content: 12. In the final revision, he made sure his work was crude.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Trong bản chỉnh sửa cuối (final revision), không ai cố tình làm tác phẩm của mình trở nên thô kệch (crude).

questions.content: 13. The captain ordered the sailor to have better posture.
questions.explanation: Correct. Thuyền trưởng ra lệnh có tư thế đứng (posture) tốt hơn.

questions.content: 14. The muscular movie star always got the role of the superhero in the movie.
questions.explanation: Correct. Ngôi sao cơ bắp (muscular) đóng vai siêu anh hùng.

questions.content: 15. On our trip, we visited the monument built for George Washington.
questions.explanation: Correct. Tượng đài (monument) được xây cho George Washington.

questions.content: 16. His ignorance led him to the final round of the tournament.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Sự thiếu hiểu biết (ignorance) không thể giúp ai đó lọt vào vòng chung kết giải đấu.

questions.content: 17. My favorite subject in college was anthropology.
questions.explanation: Correct. Môn nhân chủng học (anthropology) là một môn học.

questions.content: 18. She leaves the lights on at night because of her competence for the dark.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Năng lực (competence) không phù hợp ngữ cảnh, phải là nỗi sợ (fear).

questions.content: 19. When the couple got divorced, it was clear that they were compatible.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Nếu họ ly hôn thì họ không hề hòa hợp (compatible).

questions.content: 20. Our basketball team won the championship for three consecutive years.
questions.explanation: Correct. Vô địch 3 năm liên tiếp (consecutive) là cách dùng hoàn toàn đúng.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
Brothers

John and Mark were brothers, but they were quite different people. Mark looked very masculine. He had a mustache and was very muscular. He was a sculptor. He made things out of stone. Mark was a good artist, but he was not very intelligent.

John looked nothing like his brother. He was small and weak, but he was very smart. John was an undergraduate in college, and he studied anthropology and history. He knew a lot about ancient cultures. The brothers loved each other very much, but they thought they had nothing in common.

One day, the mayor appointed Mark to build a monument: a statue of Egyptian Pharaoh, Tut. Mark agreed to do the job, but he had a problem. He had no idea who Pharaoh Tut was! However, he thought he had the competence to build a good statue anyway. He made some crude measurements and sculpted a statue of a very old man with a tattoo on his chest. Mark was proud of his work, but when John saw the statue, he laughed aloud.

“What’s so funny?” Mark asked.

John replied, “Your ignorance makes me laugh. Don’t you know that Tut was only a teenager when he was pharaoh? Let me help you. I’ll supervise your work. I’ll give you feedback, and we’ll make this a great monument.”

Mark got another cube of stone. John told him what Tut looked like. “Make him tall with good posture,” John said. “And make sure there is symmetry in his body.”

Mark conferred with John about every detail. For ten consecutive hours, the brothers worked. At last, the finished statue was situated in front of the museum. Everyone applauded the brothers’ good work.

“We worked together very well. I guess we are compatible after all,” Mark said.

John replied, “I agree! When we combine our talents, we are capable of greatness.”

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement T for true or F for false.

questions.content: 1. Mark’s masculine features included a mustache and a muscular body.
questions.explanation: Trong bài nói Mark trông rất nam tính (masculine), anh ấy có riết mép (mustache) và cơ thể rất vạm vỡ (muscular). Nhận định này đúng.

questions.content: 2. John laughed at Pharaoh Tut’s ignorance.
questions.explanation: John cười vì sự thiếu hiểu biết của Mark (Your ignorance), chứ không phải sự thiếu hiểu biết của Pharaoh Tut. Vậy nhận định này sai.

questions.content: 3. John appointed himself to supervise Mark’s work and give him feedback about posture and symmetry.
questions.explanation: John tự nhận việc giám sát (supervise) công việc của Mark, đưa ra nhận xét (feedback), đồng thời nhắc Mark về tư thế (posture) và tính đối xứng (symmetry). Câu này đúng.

questions.content: 4. Mark made crude measurements and situated a tattoo on his original monument’s chest.
questions.explanation: Mark đã thực hiện những phép đo sơ sài (crude measurements) và khắc một hình xăm (tattoo) lên ngực bức tượng ban đầu. Nhận định này đúng.

questions.content: 5. John was an undergraduate who studied sculpture and anthropology.
questions.explanation: John là một sinh viên đại học (undergraduate) học về nhân chủng học (anthropology) và lịch sử (history), chứ không học điêu khắc (sculpture). Nhận định sai.

questions.content: 1. Why did everyone applaud the brothers after ten consecutive hours?
options: They were applauded for their hard work.
questions.explanation: Mọi người vỗ tay (applauded) khen ngợi công sức lao động chăm chỉ của hai anh em trong 10 giờ liên tục để tạo ra tác phẩm tốt. Chọn đáp án A.

questions.content: 2. What did Mark think he had the competence to do?
options: He thought he could write a book.
He thought he could build a good statue.
questions.explanation: Mark nghĩ rằng anh ấy có đủ năng lực (competence) để xây dựng một bức tượng tốt. Chọn đáp án B.

questions.content: 3. What did John explain to Mark after Mark got another cube of stone?
options: John told him what Tut looked like.
John told him to go home.
questions.explanation: Sau khi Mark lấy một khối đá (cube of stone) khác, John đã nói cho Mark biết Pharaoh Tut trông như thế nào. Chọn đáp án A.

questions.content: 4. What did Mark confer with John about?
questions.explanation: Mark đã bàn bạc (conferred) với John về từng chi tiết nhỏ (about every detail). Chọn đáp án B.

questions.content: 5. What did John say when he found out that he was compatible with his brother?
options: When we put our talents together, we are capable of greatness.
He said they should never work again.
questions.explanation: John trả lời rằng khi hai anh em (những người hòa hợp - compatible) kết hợp tài năng lại với nhau, họ có khả năng tạo nên những điều vĩ đại. Chọn đáp án B.
